profile.name: Mr. White
profile.intro: Master’s Student · Harbin Engineering University (HEU). I study Information and Communication Engineering, with a research focus on 3D scene understanding and point cloud semantic segmentation. My technical interests also include Linux, software development, and embedded systems. I use this website to share selected research, hands-on work, and technical notes.

interests.title: 3D Point Cloud Understanding
interests.description: Semantic segmentation of 3D scenes, point-cloud representations, local geometry, and feature interaction.

research.title: Representation and Feature Learning for Point Cloud Segmentation
research.description: Exploring how point-based, graph-based, voxel-based and superpoint-based representations influence geometric feature extraction and semantic segmentation. Current work includes literature analysis, baseline assessment, and experiment design. No unpublished result is claimed here.

projects.title: Point Cloud Segmentation Research
projects.description: Research workflow covering technical surveys, comparisons of representative architectures, baseline evaluation planning, and experimental design for point cloud semantic segmentation.

projects.title: Linux Systems & Engineering Practice
projects.description: Practical Linux learning on Ubuntu: shell commands, file systems and permissions, network configuration, development tools, remote access and reproducible notes.

projects.title: Microcontroller & Embedded Foundations
projects.description: Experience with 8051 microcontroller programming and interrupt mechanisms, with introductory STM32 knowledge and an electronics background. A complete public project will be added only after implementation and verification.

point-cloud-workspace.summary: Research and literature-driven engineering workflow for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation.

sections.title: Research Questions
paragraphs: How should 3D point clouds be represented? How can local geometric priors be integrated? Which feature interaction mechanism is appropriate for a given segmentation task?

sections.title: Technical Background
paragraphs: Studying point-based, graph-based, sparse voxel and superpoint approaches, alongside convolutional and attention-based feature learning. Familiar with PyTorch and CNN-based development.

sections.title: Current Work
paragraphs: Literature review, architecture comparison, baseline evaluation and experiment planning. Results will be posted only after verification and permission to disclose.
